description: With no after or cursor, get a bounded snapshot of recently updated CVEs and a checkpoint for future changes. With after, read incremental changes since a saved checkpoint. Follow nextCursor and save checkpoint only after pagination completes. Includes rejected CVEs. A recent snapshot is not a complete mirror or event history.

after.description: Checkpoint from a completed previous call. Omit when using cursor.

cursor.description: nextCursor from an unfinished incremental page. Omit when using after.

name: list_cve_updates
title: Read CVE updates
